name: dropout.
source:
After Charlie, who had just dropped out of college, loses his home, he's soon to enter back into someone's life that he has been avoiding.

[From [url=https://okaywulf.itch.io/iamnightmareinfinity]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
刚刚从大学退学的查理在失去容身之所后，很快又重新闯入了某个他一直刻意回避之人的生活。
